explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/533: δ₃(7) ≥ 1/4 via two copies of the Erdős–Rogers graph joined completely. The result is K₇-free, has ≥ N²/4 edges, and has triangle-free sets of size o(N). The statement gives, for all ε, δ > 0 and large n, a K₇-free graph with triangle-free sets ≤ δn and ≥ (1/4 − ε)n² edges. Faithful.
